class.name: sync_group_velocity_to_position_controller/SyncGroupVelocityToPositionController
class.description: Converts per-joint velocity references into position commands, with trapezoidal braking, optional pairwise group synchronization, and per-group action interfaces for drive-to-target and sync-to-position motions.

class.name: self_collision_avoidance_controller/SelfCollisionAvoidanceController
class.description: A chainable controller that only forwards joint commands if the resulting configuration is collision free.

class.name: safety_forward_controller/SafetyForwardController
class.description: A high-level forward controller ensuring that all command interfaces are stopped after receiving now commands for a specified time, i.e. disconnect to operator station.

class.name: safety_position_controller/SafetyPositionController
class.description: A chainable position controller ensuring that revolute joints are unwrapped and joint limits are satisfied.

class.name: gripper_position_effort_controller/GripperPositionEffortController
class.description: Gripper controller that simultaneously commands position and a max-effort (current/torque limit) on a single joint. Implements control_msgs/action/GripperCommand and additionally accepts position and velocity goals via topics. Publishes is_grasped (std_msgs/Bool) at action_monitor_rate. Designed for Dynamixel actuators in current-based position control mode; the effort command interface can be disabled via the effort_command_interface parameter for position-only setups (e.g. simulation).

class.name: input_shaping_controller/InputShapingController
class.description: A chainable controller that applies input shaping to reduce vibrations and improve tracking performance.
